name: Ca thieu tam
summary: Cá thiều tẩm is seasoned dried fish in long yellow strips, salty-sweet, fragrant, and hot with pepper, eaten from the packet or grilled until chewy and soft. It is a Da Nang gift to carry home.
origin: Da Nang strips seasoned with Nam Ô fish sauce, pepper, and white sugar. The fish itself is also sold as a Mekong Delta specialty.
texture: The strips are yellow, about 10–15 cm. Grilled, the meat is both chewy and soft.
taste: Sweet and fragrant when grilled, with a salty-sweet strip and the heat of pepper. Nam Ô fish sauce is the seasoning.
howToEat: Eat the strips from the packet, or grill them.

The fish is skinned, sliced thin, cut into pieces about two fingers across, mixed with the seasoning for about half an hour, and sun-dried for two days to a week, depending on the sun, then cut into strips.
where: Supermarkets and specialty shops in Da Nang.
priceBand: A 250 g box is 100,000–120,000 đồng. A cooked plate: check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ca thieu tam — seasoned dried fish from Da Nang
seoDescription: Cá thiều tẩm is a yellow dried-fish strip from Da Nang, salty-sweet and fragrant with pepper, eaten from the packet or grilled. A 250 g box is 100,000–120,000 đồng.
